column1: # The review set's coverage contract. Tab-separated, `#` for comments.
# WHAT THIS IS. `tools/review-shots.mjs` writes the frames a vision reviewer
# judges, and `tools/verify_shots.py` decides whether that set is worth
# reviewing. Until r171 the gate asked "is this a real render from a played
# bout?" and never "is every state still here?".
# It could not ask. `MIN_FRAMES = 8` is a floor on a *count*, so a set missing
# the paused overlay, the fighter pick, the half-point score and the kick at
# range — sixteen of twenty-four frames — still exits 0. Three captures have a
# guard that `return`s without writing a file (22, 23 and the r169 settings
# capture all do), so that is not a hypothetical: the tool is built to skip a
# frame quietly, and the gate cannot see it happen.
# That is r158's sentence applied to the loop's own primary instrument. A state
# that becomes reachable is not a state that has been reviewed — and here the
# states a reviewer is shown are chosen by a file nobody diffs against a list of
# what the game can show.
# HOW IT IS ENFORCED, in two halves, because there are two different failures:
#   `apps/game/tests/unit/review-set-covers-declared-frames.test.ts`  (offline,
#     in `pnpm check`) reads `review-shots.mjs` and asserts both directions —
#     every capture is declared here and every declaration is a capture. That
#     catches the AUTHOR: a new capture added without a row.
#   `tools/verify_shots.py --frames` reads this file against the set on disk and
#     fails on a declared frame that was not written. That catches the RUN: a
#     capture whose guard bailed, a browser that died on frame 22, a stale
#     frame left over from a previous set.
# THE `kind` COLUMN, and it is not decoration. A capture that photographs a
# guaranteed screen is `capture`. A capture that photographs a MOMENT — a kick
# at contact, a half on the board — can legitimately fail to find its subject,
# and its own guard `return`s without writing a file. Those are `opportunistic`
# and the gate reports a missing one as UNCOVERED rather than as a failure.
# That split is the honest reading of the harness, not a way round the gate, and
# the debt is stated rather than hidden: three of the twenty-four frames are
# opportunistic, and across the retained loop logs their guards fired 10, 8 and
# 8 times — so `18-phone-kick` is missing from roughly one review set in six and
# `19-phone-half-point`, r148's entire round, from about one in five. **Four
# review passes argued about that half-point notation, and on most of those sets
# the half point was not in them.** Making the gate strict on them would leave it
# permanently red, and a gate that cries wolf gets deleted; making it silent is
# what this file exists to stop. So it prints.
# Proved able to fail in `tools/verify-shots-mutation.sh`.
# ADDING A ROW is not enough on its own — the same rule `tools/art-manifest.tsv`
# carries. A capture that is not photographed is not declared, and a declaration
# the gate enforces but the tool never writes is a red gate, not a covered state.
# name
